verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Svelte's source is publicly hosted on GitHub at github.com/sveltejs/svelte, with a public roadmap and community contribution channels, so reading the source is plausibly supported. However, nothing in the pack names or confirms an open-source license, which is half of what the story asks. Missing for 10: an explicit open-license statement (e.g. MIT) in the evidence, and independent corroboration of the license terms.
